page.layout: One printed page scan, no text: only paper discolouration, foxing and stains are visible.
page.notes: The scan shows a blank leaf with no printed text, no page number, no running head, no catchword and no signature. Visible marks are only stains: a brownish blot near the centre, a darker stain at the top right corner, a small dark ink spot near the lower right, and scattered specks of paper fibre. The lower right corner shows a light edge that appears to be the neighbouring page or the digitiser's background, which is not transcribed.
